**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Re-run the original fixture before comparing the baseline**

When Use Case 5 adds patches for the new seeds, reporting only the original thirteen result IDs does not make those results comparable with the 2026-09-10 baseline: `runRecallBenchmark` supplies the entire `changedFiles` array in one model prompt (`src/cli/recall-benchmark.ts:156-164`), so the additional patches can change model behavior or truncation for the original defects. This can misattribute a context-induced recall change to the sweep. Require separate runs against the original fixture version, with the historical model/configuration controlled, or remove the claim that the subset preserves baseline comparability.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
